title: Normalize missing Result references for context-memory actions
root_cause: Agent2 error normalization omitted ScientificResultSnapshotNotFound, so pinning a missing Result surfaced as a generic 500.

change.behavior: Map ScientificResultSnapshotNotFound to the existing stable Agent2 resource-not-found response.

assertions: No scientific data or session memory authority is mutated by the error path.
Existing object, version, turn and session not-found mappings remain unchanged.
